titleText.es: La policía informa de la presencia de varias docenas de espectadores contentos, pero ninguno afirma haber visto al que lo hizo.
titleText.en: Police reported three dozen cheerful bystanders, yet no one claims to have seen who did it.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish archive preserves the complete title text and naturally generalizes the official three dozen as varias docenas, “several dozen.”
